newsitem.title: USA: Hughes Supply to buy Detroit pool supplier.
newsitem.headline: Hughes Supply to buy Detroit pool supplier.

text.p: Hughes Supply Inc said Monday it has signed an agreement with the shareholders of Palm Pool Products Inc to buy Palm for an undisclosed number of shares of Hughes common stock.

Hughes is a diversified distributor of construction materials and supplies in the Southeast and Midwest. Palm is a pool supplies distributor headquartered in Detroit, Michigan whose estimated sales for FY96 ending December 31 are about $10 million.
Hughes said it believes the acquisition won't dilute earnings per share.
Hughes reported earnings per share of $.90 for its second quarter ended July 31, which it said is a 17 percent increase over the prior year on 28 percent more shares outstanding.
Hughes was trading up 1/8 at 38 1/8 Monday afternoon.
